English.Char_Desc_45: Free offline PDF tools with no file limit
English.Char_Desc_80: Merge, split, rotate and watermark PDFs on your own machine, with no upload
English.Char_Desc_250: PDFGeek merges, splits, rotates and watermarks PDF files on your own machine. There is no upload, no account and no cap on how many files you can merge - which is the thing the web tools charge for.
English.Char_Desc_450: PDFGeek merges, splits, rotates and watermarks PDF files entirely on your own machine. The web tools cap a free merge at a handful of files and charge for more; PDFGeek has no cap at all. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and the documents never leave the computer they are on - which matters for anything confidential. Free, with no Pro tier and no subscription.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
PDFGeek merges, splits, rotates and watermarks PDF files on your own machine.
The online tools cap a free merge at a handful of files and charge for anything more. PDFGeek has no cap. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account, and the documents never leave the computer they are on, which matters for anything under NDA.
No Pro tier, no subscription, no ads and no bundled offers. Windows 10 1809 or later, 64-bit. Free to use, including at work.
